name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 measures folding stability only. It does not measure a partner or phosphatase interface, or the Y701 region, so it does not bear on H1. The FoldX value of -0.60 kcal/mol neither supports nor contradicts a surface-engagement mechanism."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 gives no intra-chain contact or inter-domain distance for residue 274, so it does not test whether R274W breaks a coiled-coil to DNA-binding or N-terminal domain contact. The stability value does not decide that question."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "The predicted change is not destabilising: FoldX ddG = -0.60 kcal/mol, below the 2.0 kcal/mol threshold, at residue pLDDT 94.62 (confident region, so the value is applicable). The same-site substitutions R274G (+1.42) and R274Q (+0.32) are less stabilising than R274W at this residue, which argues against the coiled-coil being destabilised by this site. The would_refute criterion was not fully met: the ddG is within the roughly 1 kcal/mol FoldX error, but the folding and expression-level part (wild-type STAT1 levels) was not measured, so H3 is weakened, not refuted."}], "uncertainty": "T1 is a FoldX estimate on one AlphaFold model, with errors near 1 kcal/mol, so a -0.60 value cannot separate neutral from mildly stabilising. It does not measure expression or degradation, which H3 needs, and it does not measure any interface, pocket, or contact, so H1 and H2 are not tested. Its controls: pLDDT 94.62 shows the site is confidently modelled, and the same-site R274G and R274Q gave higher ddG values, so the method reports a site-specific difference. Validation still needed: a structural context test (T2) for H1, a structure comparison (T3, needs approval) for H2, and a protein-level expression or degradation measurement for H3. Note that Missense3D reports \"Damaging\" for R274W, which is a sequence- or structure-based call and does not change the FoldX result."}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H1", "why": "Previous favourite H1 stays favoured; the rival with the most direct support is H2 (not H3). T1 did not address H1 or H2, so neither gained or lost support from it. H1 keeps its direct literature support for this exact substitution: E2 (UniProt VAR_065943, R274W gain of function with increased IFN-driven phosphorylation from loss of dephosphorylation), E7 (Petersen et al., elevated phosphorylation and prolonged nuclear accumulation), E9 (Giovannozzi et al., increased phosphorylation and faster nuclear accumulation), and E16 (impaired STAT1 dephosphorylation). H2 has indirect support only: E3 and E4 (coiled-coil and helix annotations) and E5 (domain match), with no residue-level contact evidence for 274. T1 (test result, verdict not_predicted_destabilising, ddG -0.60 kcal/mol, pLDDT 94.62) weakened H3, which was the rival least consistent with the gain-of-function literature in E2, E7 and E9. H1 is favoured on literature evidence, not on structure: no test yet shows residue 274 at a partner or phosphatase interface. The decision therefore did not change."}
